tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company had received a demand notice from Assessing officer, Income Tax for the FY 2011-12 amounting Rs. 762.23 lakhs.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed an appeal with Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeal) against the order received from Assessing Officer. The case is with CIT appeal and there is no change in the status from last quarter. The Company has received an Order dated 05 May 2026 passed under Section 250 of the Income-tax Act, 1961 for Assessment Year 2012-13. The said order pertains to the appeal filed against the assessment order passed under Section 143(3). The appellate authority has adjudicated various additions/disallowances made by the Assessing Officer, and the outcome of the order is largely in favour of the Company. Significant relief has been granted on key disputed matters. The order, inter alia, states that: “The AO, in treating the amount received of Rs. 15,00,00,000/- by the appellant in the form of contribution towards CCDs/Equity shares as unexplained cash credits, is found to be untenable. Accordingly, the addition made by the AO of Rs. 15,00,00,000/- as unexplained cash credits in the assessment order passed under Section 143(3) of the Act is hereby deleted.”

timeline.summary: On April 30, 2026, Arman Financial filed its annual disclosure of outstanding non-convertible debentures for FY 2025-26, confirming timely debt servicing.
Arman Financial received a favorable CIT(A) order on May 5, 2026, deleting a ₹15 crore tax addition for AY 2012-13.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹175.58 Cr (-11.9% YoY), net profit ₹41.01 Cr (+221.4% YoY).
Arman Financial Services Limited’s **Uttam Patel** and **Narayanbhai Patel** uploaded the audio recording of the May 29, 2026, conference call on financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26.
Arman Financial Services reported Q4 and FY26 earnings with AUM reaching ₹2,728 crore and Q4 PAT at ₹41 crore.
Jayendrabhai Bhailalbhai Patel, Promoter of Arman Financial Services Limited, declared no encumbrances on shares by promoters or PAC during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
CareEdge reaffirmed Arman Financial's NCD rating at 'CARE A-' and revised the outlook from Negative to Stable.
